title: record_amendments
description: Payroll instructions found in a case email thread, relative to the pay items extracted from the attachment.

action.description: add = new pay item; modify = change value of existing item(s); exclude = do not pay existing item(s); confirm = approval or confirmation, no change; info = instruction not about these pay items.

target_item_ids.description: item_ids from the provided list that this instruction changes or excludes.

new_value.description: For add/modify: values as written in the email.

code_text.description: Code or earning type as written (e.g. 'sick', '23', 'vacation').

relates_to_this_attachment.description: False when the instruction is clearly about a different attachment or a future payroll.
